description: Vertical eye-level forest background for Region 1 'Mana Forest'. Thick trunks frame the left and right edges, foliage forms a canopy, warm light shafts descend from the upper-left, distant trees recede into cool mist, and the lower third is a flat moss-and-leaf ground plane with the central staging area kept open.
usage: Opening battle/exploration background behind wizard and enemy sprites; may later support a swamp variant with fog/water overlays.
style_summary: Chunky but detailed vertical pixel-art forest with 2px dominant physical pixel blocks, lower saturation/contrast than character sprites, strong edge framing, misty depth, and warm upper-left light shafts.

visual_identity.frame: massive trunks on both outer edges with leafy canopy overhead
visual_identity.ground: flat moss-and-leaf plane across lower third
visual_identity.distance: cool green/teal mist with softened tree silhouettes

silhouette_profile: Dark framing masses on left/right and canopy top; bright open center; low flat floor with edge rocks and roots.

proportion_profile.vertical_layout: canopy upper zone, misty mid-depth forest, flat playable floor in lower third

pixel_structure.method_note: Final scene is represented at 512x768 logical pixels and expanded 2x with nearest-neighbor; no fixed-palette quantization.

pixel_density: finer than characters: approximately 2x2 physical pixels per logical cell at 1024x1536

palette_profile.contrast_policy: background contrast and saturation one step below character sprites

shading_profile: Layered atmospheric depth with broad value grouping; local texture remains pixel-structured but lower contrast toward center distance.

lighting_profile.light_shafts: diagonal warm beams descending into the center-left clearing

outline_profile: Environment edges use dark local hues rather than uniform black outlines.

texture/material_profile.tree_bark: dark brown-green rough trunks with moss
texture/material_profile.ground: soft moss, scattered leaves and small exposed roots
texture/material_profile.rocks: dark desaturated stone restricted mainly to edges
texture/material_profile.mist: soft cool atmospheric layering in distance

detail_density: high at outer edges and canopy, low-to-medium in central playable area.
readability_rules: Keep center-lower area free of large objects.
Ground across lower third must read as level and horizontally continuous.
No cliffs, stairs or strong slopes.
Keep center lower in contrast than sprite silhouettes.
Place fine decorative detail toward side edges, not behind characters.
No people, monsters, text or UI frames.
Floor should remain compatible with later fog/water swamp overlay.
mood/world_context: mysterious but welcoming first-region forest; magical rather than threatening
consistency_must_keep: green/teal palette with warm yellow light only
allowed_variations: small root and leaf-litter pattern changes
variant_generation_notes: For swamp reuse, add fog/wetness/water overlays while preserving the same horizontal floor plane and central staging clearance. Keep edge trees as framing anchors.
relation_to_other_assets: Shared upper-left light and colored-edge treatment with wizard_back and enemy_goblin_scout; intentionally lower visual dominance so both sprites remain readable.
reference_basis: ART_REQUEST_PHASE1_5.md for scene, palette, staging, camera and pixel-density requirements; supplied wizard image for overall project rendering quality only.
originality_note: Original generic fantasy forest composition for this project; no specific commercial-game environment was intentionally copied.
license_risk_check: Low; no external logos, trademarks, text, or identifiable proprietary environment motifs intentionally reproduced.
